title: UnstableSMP Simulator
description:
MOST UPDATED Unstable Simulator(+Civil War)

This is a Minecraft modpack page for the Cindercrest Battle Simulator by TheMapGuy and Unstable SMP Battle Simulator by CarpetPVPMap with pre-installed PvP and performance mods
body:
# ⚠️ THIS SIMULATOR DOES NOT BELONG TO ME

![Unstable SMP: The LAW](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5900f25dd38ff46d1e2cde098e1847c735414c4e.jpeg)
*Image from [Wemmbu](https://youtu.be/f_aRA-KcTQs)*

---

## 📦 About

I made this modpack for players to install Unstable Simulator **more easily** — without the tedious process of installing maps, selecting mods, and configuring everything manually.

**All the necessary mods for PvP and optimization are pre-installed.**

---

## 🗺️ Maps

### 🌟 Special Thanks — Cindercrest Battle Simulator Premiere

A huge thank you to **TheMapGuy** for letting me **premiere the Cindercrest Battle Simulator** right here in this modpack! 🔥

> 🎉 This modpack gets the **first public showcase** of the map — it's an honor!
> Make sure to go support **TheMapGuy** and check out their other work!


All Credits to _**TheMapGuy**_ and  _**[CarpetPVPMaps](https://www.youtube.com/@CarpetPVPMaps)**_

## 👥 Multiplayer

You can use [Essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential) to play with others!

> ⚠️ Your friends need to have the **same modpack** installed too.

---

## 💻 Custom Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/trigger lobby` | Teleports you back to the lobby |
| `/trigger stab` | Gives you orbital stab shot |
| `/trigger nuke` | Gives you orbital nuke shot |
